plan.notes: Official Montclair State University 2026-2027 catalog page 'Marketing Concentration - Business Administration (B.S.)', 'Recommended Roadmap to Program of Study Completion' (120 credits; catalog prints Total Credits 120). This is the Marketing concentration roadmap of the Business Administration B.S.; the roadmap notes it is a recommendation to be used with an academic advisor and assumes no prerequisite coursework. ACCT 204 is used per the roadmap (finance-concentration students take ACCT 201 instead). Concentration electives (3): choose from the catalog's Marketing Concentration Requirements elective list (e.g. MKTG 250, 307, 309, 310, 322, 325, 342, 344, 345, 350, 351, 360, 365, 375, 387, 390, 391, 395, 401, 425, 441, 443, 447, 451, 483, 490, 492, 493). Major elective: choose from the catalog's Business Administration Major Electives list. SEEDS slots are recorded as choice slots; specific SEEDS courses are chosen with an advisor. Per-term sums verified against the catalog's printed term totals (16/15/15/15/15/15/15/14 = 120).
